result.summary: The page is largely well-designed and functional. After excluding the intentional horizontal carousel clipping (category chips and 'Fastest near you' row) and the bottom-viewport card cutoff, one minor visual defect remains: the third restaurant card's title 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated by the right screen edge, which is part of the scrollable row and thus treated as a feature. No genuine visual breakage was found beyond expected scroll affordances.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel's third card title 'Trattoria Piccol' is clipped at the right edge with no visible scroll indicator or fade gradient to signal horizontal scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade gradient or scroll hint so users understand the row is horizontally scrollable, even though the partial clipping itself is intended behavior.
